description: Analysis of MiroFish, BookWorld, OpenStory integration into niko-studio for M11 Phase 1

core_capabilities: Seed information extraction from real-world data
Thousands of agents with independent personalities + long-term memory
Role agents with static + dynamic attributes
STM (short-term) + LTM (long-term) memory with capacity limits
Incremental character profile extraction from source text

validation.ablation_key_finding: Removing environment response significantly hurts immersion; removing scene mode hurts all dimensions

core_capabilities: Lifecycle plugins: perception → planning → execution → reflection
1:1 visual frontend with map-based agent tracking
Character profile generation from source materials
Redis-based data bus for distributed simulation

tier1_architecture.integration: Add worldview extraction pipeline: chunk → atomic facts → filter → cluster → terminology. Extract term/nature/detail/source from user's novel chapters. Inject into Agent prompts as context.
Add scene-driven simulation mode to workflow engine. Scene = minimal narrative unit. Multiple role agents act per scene. Dynamic initiator selection based on character state.

Enhance character agent with: 1) static/dynamic attribute separation, 2) open-domain natural language action space, 3) STM+LTM memory with capacity limits and auto-abstraction. Leverage existing memory/six-dimensional-memory.ts for LTM.

Refactor agent base to support lifecycle hooks: perception → planning → execution → reflection. Make existing agent capabilities (sequential-thinking.ts, critic.ts etc.) into pluggable lifecycle stages.

Enhance worldbuilding agent with: 1) environmental response generation based on worldview settings, 2) event generation and dynamic updates for story stimulation, 3) NPC management (temporary memoryless agents).

tier2_features.integration: Add branch point markers to workflow sessions. Support backtracking to past nodes with alternative choices. Visualize as tree structure.
Add weighted undirected graph for location distances. Track character positions. Scene participant selection based on co-location. Movement consumes scene turns.
Auto-construct GraphRAG from novel chapters. Extract seed entities/relationships. Enable graph-enhanced retrieval for agent prompts.
Post-simulation LLM rephrasing: convert simulation records (structured action logs) into novel-style narrative prose. Adds 'simulation → narrative' pipeline.
Add map-based character tracking UI. Show character positions on geospatial map. Click to view character details and status.

tier3_strategic.integration: Sandbox mode: multiple character agents interact freely in virtual world, observe emergent plot lines. For plot preview and character behavior validation.
God's-eye view: user defines hypothetical conditions, system simulates multiple possible story trajectories. Generate narrative paths for user selection.
Runtime dynamic agent add/remove. User can introduce new characters during simulation without restart.
YAML-based story world configuration: system rules, environment settings, action definitions, agent profiles. User-editable without code changes.

phase_1_foundation.focus: Data extraction + agent enhancement (no UI changes)

backward_compatibility.reason: All integrations are additive. Existing M1-M12 features are not modified. New capabilities are opt-in via configuration.

performance.reason: Scene simulation + multi-agent interaction increases LLM API calls. Need debouncing, caching, and lazy loading for large projects.
performance.mitigation: Virtualize simulation results, debounce style extraction (already done in M12), batch API calls where possible.

llm_dependency.reason: Worldview extraction and scene simulation heavily depend on LLM quality. BookWorld paper shows Llama-3.3-70B underperforms on complex multi-agent tasks.
llm_dependency.mitigation: Use strongest available model for extraction/simulation. Provide manual override/edit for extracted data. Cache extraction results.

scope_creep.reason: Three external projects represent massive scope. Risk of over-engineering or feature bloat.
scope_creep.mitigation: Strict phased implementation. Each phase delivers standalone value. Tier 3 items are explicitly strategic (not immediate).
